pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 30

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 4

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 9
   D. 8

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/2

7. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 15
   D. 22

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 16
   C. 22
   D. 55

14. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

16. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

18. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 43
   D. 1

19. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

21. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 20
   C. 75
   D. 40

23. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 14

24. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

25. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

26. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 25
   C. 31
   D. 27

27. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 10
   C. 6
   D. 15

28. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

29. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 20
   D. 9

30. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
